All ten original order3/4 global/local/baseline stages are true. Eight batch03 later-five-window fields explicitly support their contexts. Older 0129 has no such field and is absent from the later followup; its two later entries stay null/unassessed, distinct from original true support.

C019 reuses seven C018 observations and five native products. Newly bounded spectral windows are disjoint, without asserting independence of complete historical raw crops or observations. Original C019 epoch/raw evidence already existed; no new, blind or untouched observing evidence is claimed.

prior_wavelength_dependency.interpretation: All seven observations and five native products are reused from C018. Bounded spectral windows differ, but original epoch/raw evidence already existed and observation/full-crop independence is not implied. C005 numeric overlap is another target with disjoint products/pixels.

reference_pair_dependence.interpretation: Metadata combinatorics of seven reused observations, not independent samples or new numerical comparisons.
